svg.title: find_anomalies lights up entities beyond theta
svg.desc: An agent calls find_anomalies and explain_anomaly over MCP; on the right, the population of accounts in delta space: the theta boundary draws in, the seven entities beyond it light up, and the top one is explained by its witness dimension. Distance from the centroid is real (sqrt of delta_norm / theta_norm); angles are illustrative.
svg.text: θ comes from the population: no labels, no tuning.
